senses.gloss:
बोद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be observed or re-
garded, observable, to be attended to; to be per-
ceived, perceptible, to be recognised; to be known
or understood, intelligible; to be wakened or roused;
to be enlightened, to be admonished; to be informed,
one whose attention is to be called to anything.

बोद्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, one who knows or
understands; an observer.
—बोद्धृ-त्व, अम्, n.
the being one who knows or understands, knowing,
capacity for understanding.
